154021f483b985af.description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

At Elation, our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life. We are a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform on a mission to enable every patient to receive the highest quality of care. Since inception, we’ve been focused on building a delightful, world‑class customer experience that empowers physicians to focus on delivering phenomenal care to patients.

Elation Health is looking for a Senior Manager, Training & Enablement to build and lead a dedicated function that strengthens how our employees and customers learn.

As Elation grows, we’re investing in a coordinated, scalable approach to training and education. You’ll lead a small, nimble team and own internal learning programs for Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Onboarding, Support, and other teams. You’ll also set the direction for customer education, partnering with customer-facing leaders to develop programs for new and existing customers.

This is a hands-on leadership role with the opportunity to shape the function’s strategy, programs, and ways of working. You’ll coach your team while staying directly involved in curriculum development, content creation, and training delivery.

This role reports to the Director of Product and Customer Marketing and works closely with leaders and subject matter experts across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Build and lead the function

• Establish a training and enablement strategy aligned with company goals and functional priorities.

• Lead needs analysis: identify performance gaps, determine where training will have the biggest impact, and prioritize from that analysis rather than primarily responding to requests for courses.

• Evaluate existing programs and resources, identify opportunities to strengthen them, and develop a roadmap for growth.

• Manage and develop a small team, setting clear priorities, responsibilities, and quality standards.

• Establish consistent processes for training requests, program development, and content maintenance.

Develop and deliver internal learning programs

• Own role-based onboarding and ongoing training for customer-facing teams, adapting content to each audience’s responsibilities.

• Collaborate with commercial leaders to develop training that supports their commercial strategy and priorities.

• Design and facilitate live and on-demand learning covering products, workflows, launches, and role-specific skills.

• Partner with functional leaders and subject matter experts to translate complex information into clear, actionable instruction.

• Reinforce learning after the session through hands-on practice, job aids, manager coaching resources, and train-the-trainer programs so new skills hold up on the job.

Expand customer education

• Support the customer education strategy and roadmap, in partnership with the teams that deliver customer onboarding and training today, so priorities are clear and content is not duplicated.

• Build a mix of live sessions and self-guided content tailored to different customer roles and experience levels, and set the standard for how customer education content is produced and kept current.

• Use customer questions and feedback to keep education relevant as our products and customers’ needs evolve.

Improve how we work and measure success

• Use AI to accelerate content development and program maintenance while maintaining accuracy and quality.

• Develop tools and workflows that make learning resources easy to find, use, and keep current.

• Measure behavior change, not just completion. Use learner feedback, assessments, on-the-job application, and business outcomes to show where learning is changing how people work and where it is not.

Priorities for the First 6-12 Months

This role spans strategy, people management, content development, and customer education. In the first year, the emphasis is on:

• Establish a needs-driven approach. Assess existing programs and requests across customer-facing teams, identify the biggest performance gaps, and set priorities from that analysis rather than from the queue of course requests.

• Rebuild onboarding for priority roles. Focus first on the highest-volume customer-facing roles, with practice, reinforcement, and manager coaching built in from the start.

• Stand up the function. Build and develop the team, define how training requests are triaged and prioritized, and set quality and maintenance standards for content.

• Set the customer education direction. Agree with customer-facing leaders on what this role owns versus what stays with the teams delivering customer education today, and build the roadmap from there.

• Establish measurement. Define how we will track behavior change and business outcomes so we can show impact within the first year.

What We’re Looking For / Professional Qualifications

• Training and enablement experience. 7+ years of experience in training, learning and development, enablement, or a related field, including 2+ years managing and developing a team. You’re willing to contribute directly to content creation and delivery.

• Experience across customer-facing and commercial teams. A track record of developing and leading training for multiple functions, such as Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Onboarding, and Support.

• Healthcare technology experience. Experience working in healthcare SaaS or healthcare technology.

• Needs analysis and performance consulting. You start with the performance gap, not the course request, and you can show how you decided where training would have the biggest impact.

• Demonstrated learning design expertise. You can structure effective learning experiences, engage different audiences, and help people apply what they learn on the job. A formal instructional design background is not required, but proven learning design work is.

• A builder’s mindset. You’ve launched or significantly expanded programs or functions, translating business needs into practical solutions that scale.

• Cross-functional influence. You build trusted relationships, draw on subject matter expertise, and align stakeholders around shared priorities.

• Practical AI fluency. You have experience using AI in your work and can assess where it adds value and where human judgment is essential.

• Adaptability and initiative. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, anticipating needs, and adjusting plans as new opportunities emerge.

Nice to Have

• Formal training or certification in instructional design or adult learning.

• Experience developing external customer education programs.

• Experience with EHR and revenue cycle management (RCM) technology.

• Familiarity with learning management systems and content authoring tools, and revenue intelligence platforms such as Gong.

Salary range: $135,000-165,000

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

An overview of this role

As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. What you’ll do

  • Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.
  • Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.
  • Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.

  • Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.

What you’ll bring

  • Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.
  • Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.
  • Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.
  • Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.
  • Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.
  • Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.
  • Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.

About the team

Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. 1505a0959e9234fc.description: # DevOps Engineer ## About timepay.ai timepay.ai builds AI voice agents and WhatsApp and SMS automation for businesses across industries. Our platform runs lead generation, sales, customer support, retail and collections conversations at scale. ## The role You will own the cloud infrastructure behind real-time voice and messaging at scale. Your work keeps the platform fast, secure, reliable and cost-efficient. We run mainly on GCP, with some workloads on AWS. You will design and automate environments, build CI/CD, secure networks and data, and keep costs in check. ## What we run Our applications are built with Node.js, Python, WebSockets and Next.js. They run on PostgreSQL, Redis and Elasticsearch, packaged with Docker on GCP and AWS. ## What you'll do **Cloud infrastructure (GCP-heavy, plus AWS)** - Design, build and run infrastructure on GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) and AWS (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3 and related services). - Manage everything as code with Terraform: reusable modules, remote state and separate dev, staging and production environments. - Run and scale Docker workloads on Kubernetes, and manage PostgreSQL, Redis and Elasticsearch in production. **Networking and security** - Design VPCs, subnets, firewalls, load balancers, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPNs and private connectivity between clouds and customer networks. - Secure environments: IAM with least privilege, secrets management, encryption, network segmentation, WAF and DDoS protection. - Set up audit logging, vulnerability scanning and patching, and support compliance needs such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001. **CI/CD and automation** - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, GitLab CI or similar) with automated tests, image builds and safe rollouts. - Support zero-downtime deploys with blue-green or canary releases and quick rollbacks. - Automate repetitive operational work with scripts in Bash or Python. **Reliability, monitoring and optimisation** - Set up monitoring, logging, tracing and alerts (Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK or similar). - Own backups, disaster recovery and high availability for critical services. - Tune performance and autoscaling for real-time WebSocket and voice traffic. - Cut cloud costs through rightsizing, committed-use discounts, spot instances and cleanup of unused resources. - Lead incident response and blameless post-mortems. ## What success looks like * 30 days: Audited our GCP and AWS setup, CI/CD and security; shared a prioritised list of gaps; shipped quick wins. * 60 days: Brought key infrastructure under Terraform; improved CI/CD so deploys are faster and safer; set up core alerts and dashboards. * 90 days: Hardened network and IAM security; tested backup and disaster recovery; delivered a measurable cut in cloud costs. ## What we're looking for - 2+ years in DevOps, SRE, platform or cloud engineering. - Strong hands-on GCP experience (GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, IAM, VPC, Cloud Build or similar) and working AWS experience. - Solid networking: TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, VPC design, firewalls, NAT, VPNs and TLS. - Terraform in production: modules, state management and multi-environment setups. - Docker and Kubernetes in production. - Experience building CI/CD pipelines from scratch. - Security mindset: IAM, secrets management, hardening and least privilege. - Scripting in Bash and Python; comfortable on Linux. - Experience with monitoring and logging tools and with on-call incident handling. - Ownership and clear communication with developers. ## Good to have - GCP or AWS certifications. - Helm, Argo CD or other GitOps tools. - Running PostgreSQL, Redis and Elasticsearch at scale. - Real-time or WebSocket-heavy workloads, telephony or media servers. - Cloud cost optimisation (FinOps). - Compliance work such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or the DPDP Act. ## Why join timepay.ai - Own the infrastructure of a fast-growing AI platform, with real say over how it is built. - Work on hard problems: real-time voice at scale, multi-cloud networking and security. - See the direct impact of your work on uptime, speed and cost. - Competitive salary and flexible work.

Hex is one of the fastest-growing AI-native data platforms, and enterprise is our next frontier: we're expanding beyond early adopters and digital-native customers to win the largest, most established organizations in the market. We're hiring an Enterprise Sales Manager to lead and build out the western portion of our Enterprise AE team as we scale into this next phase of growth. This is a true build role: you'll shape how we hire, ramp, and coach Enterprise AEs, and play a defining role in how Hex shows up in your market, from positioning to executive relationships to partner presence. You'll coach a team through high velocity, complex, multi stakeholder sales cycles, acting as a strategic partner to your reps as they navigate competitive, high stakes deals.

What you will do

• Recruit, hire, and ramp a growing Enterprise AE team, building a repeatable onboarding and coaching program.

• Coach reps through complex, multi stakeholder enterprise deals, from new pipeline generation to existing account growth, running deal reviews and call coaching that improve win rate and velocity.

• Establish operating rhythms (1:1s, pipeline reviews, QBRs, call reviews) and coaching frameworks that raise team performance.
